command: cd /workspace/inventory && git log --oneline -15 && echo "---STATUS---" && git status --short && echo "---FILES---" && ls -R inventory tests
cd /workspace/inventory && ls -la && find . -name '*.py' -not -path '*/__pycache__/*' | sort && echo "---CONFTEST---" && cat tests/conftest.py
cd /workspace/inventory && cat README.md CHANGELOG.md TODO.md pyproject.toml .env && echo "---GNOMON---" && find .gnomon -type f | head -50

cd /workspace/inventory && for f in .gnomon/config.toml .gnomon/policy.toml .gnomon/system.md .gnomon/roles.toml .gnomon/tools.toml .gnomon/profiles/local_first.toml .gnomon/skills/writing-tests.md .gnomon/skills/secrets.md .gnomon/skills/endpoints-and-models.md; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done
